name: study-buddy
description:
What is this?
• A plugin with ready-made instructions that lets Claude help you study more efficiently.

What does it do?
• Helps students plan their studies, study with Claude, and stay accountable each day.

Features
• Study plans • Quizzes and flashcards • Cheat sheets from your notes • Daily log • Optional Notion or Google Drive

How to use it
• Type a slash (/) and it will show you the skills, or just type "how to use this" to get started.

Happy learning!
